title: The default network: numbers work, names don't
subtitle: Every container gets its own IP address. On the default network, Docker keeps no list of names.

notes.text:
IP address = a room number.
Container name = the name on the door.

On the default network every room has a number, but nobody keeps a list of names. So box2 can reach 172.17.0.2, but 'box1' means nothing to it.

docker run -d --name box1 busybox:1.37 sleep 3600
docker run -d --name box2 busybox:1.37 sleep 3600
docker exec box2 ping -c 2 172.17.0.2     # works
docker exec box2 ping -c 1 box1           # ping: bad address 'box1'
